description:
A policy research organization needs to analyze the global distribution of major populated places across countries. Using Natural Earth datasets already available in ~/GIS_Data/natural_earth/, perform the following steps in QGIS:

1. Add the country boundaries layer from ~/GIS_Data/natural_earth/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp
2. Add the populated places layer from ~/GIS_Data/natural_earth/ne_110m_populated_places.shp
3. Use Vector > Analysis Tools > Count Points in Polygon with:
   - Polygon layer: ne_110m_admin_0_countries
   - Point layer: ne_110m_populated_places
   - Count field name: NUMPOINTS (the default)
4. Export the resulting layer (countries with the added NUMPOINTS field) as a GeoJSON file to:
   /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/countries_with_place_count.geojson

The output should contain all country polygons with a NUMPOINTS field showing how many populated places fall within each country.
